# Gandi.net
> Domain registrar and infrastructure provider offering domain names, email, SSL certificates, web hosting, and cloud VPS services.

Gandi provides domain management, DNS, email, TLS/SSL certificates, website hosting, and cloud infrastructure for individuals, businesses, resellers, and enterprise customers.

## Core Products
- [Domain Names](https://www.gandi.net/en/domain): Search, register, transfer, and manage domain names with DNS and bundled services.
- [Custom Email Addresses](https://www.gandi.net/en/domain/email): Create professional mailbox addresses and forwarding linked to your domain names.
- [TLS/SSL Certificates](https://www.gandi.net/en/security): Purchase and manage TLS/SSL certificates for website and service encryption.
- [Web Hosting](https://www.gandi.net/en/simple-hosting): Host websites and applications with managed hosting plans and deployment options.
- [GandiCloud VPS](https://www.gandi.net/en/cloud/vps): Deploy virtual private servers for scalable workloads and custom infrastructure.
- [GandiCloud Block Storage](https://www.gandi.net/en/cloud/block-storage): Attach persistent block storage volumes to cloud server instances.

## Website Creation Solutions
- [Create a Website](https://www.gandi.net/en/solutions/create-website): Overview of website creation options for business, content, and online store projects.
- [Create a Showcase Website](https://www.gandi.net/en/solutions/create-website/showcase-site): Build a presentation website for a company, portfolio, or professional activity.
- [Open an E-commerce Shop](https://www.gandi.net/en/solutions/create-website/ecommerce-site): Launch an online store with hosting and domain services for selling products.
- [Create a Blog](https://www.gandi.net/en/solutions/create-website/blog-site): Start a blog-oriented website with suitable hosting and publishing tools.
- [Small- and Medium-Sized Business Solutions](https://www.gandi.net/en/solutions/step-by-step-professional-website): Step-by-step guidance for building a professional website for SMB needs.

## Hosting Solutions
- [Web Hosting](https://www.gandi.net/en/simple-hosting): Managed hosting plans for websites, applications, and common CMS deployments.
- [Hosting for WordPress](https://www.gandi.net/en/simple-hosting/wordpress): WordPress-focused hosting option for blogs, business sites, and content publishing.
- [Hosting for Prestashop](https://www.gandi.net/en/simple-hosting/prestashop): Hosting tailored for Prestashop-based e-commerce websites and storefronts.
- [Hosting for Nextcloud](https://www.gandi.net/en/simple-hosting/nextcloud): Managed hosting suitable for self-hosted file sharing and collaboration with Nextcloud.

## Cloud Infrastructure
- [GandiCloud VPS](https://www.gandi.net/en/cloud/vps): Virtual servers for custom stacks, development environments, and production workloads.
- [GandiCloud Block Storage](https://www.gandi.net/en/cloud/block-storage): Persistent storage volumes for cloud instances requiring flexible capacity and durability.

## Security and Certificates
- [TLS/SSL Certificates](https://www.gandi.net/en/security): Certificate offerings for securing websites, services, and encrypted communications.
- [Custom Email Addresses](https://www.gandi.net/en/domain/email): Domain-based email services supporting professional identity, aliases, and forwarding.

## Business Services
- [Advanced Small/Medium Business Services](https://www.gandi.net/en/small-medium-businesses): Service offerings for growing organizations with more advanced operational requirements.
- [Large Account Services](https://www.gandi.net/en/corporate): Enterprise-oriented support and account services for larger organizations and complex portfolios.
- [Gandi Reseller Program](https://www.gandi.net/en/reseller): Reseller offering for partners managing domains and related services for customers.

## Account and Administration
- [Log in](https://admin.gandi.net/?locale=en): Access the Gandi administration interface for domains, hosting, billing, and account settings.
